description: fylite — a self-contained tokamak equilibrium / transport / turbulence kernel. ONE command line, built from this file twice: the Rust executable `fy` (compiled in; carries app / data / run / list) and the browser app (its launch parameters are the `hosts.app.params` below). ★2026-09-04 the Python host left: that package is a LIBRARY now, with no console script and no argparse layer. Same day, second ruling: `case` folded into `run` (one entry to the kernel door, taking either a line and scenario or the plan files themselves) and the discovery face gathered into `list`; what those words were is in `retired`, and the parser refuses them BY NAME with the replacement (FYL-DESIGN-17 E-10 / E-23 / E-24).

rust.note: THE executable, and since 2026-09-04 the ONLY one: named `fy` (it was `fylite-app`, then `fylite` — the same name as the Python console script, which made a $PATH lookup find that script itself and fork forever; the Python command line has since been removed altogether and this package is a library). The whole app/ is embedded and every command word is carried here: `app`, `data`, `run`, `list` — one verb each: serve the page, move data, compute, look. With no subcommand it runs `app` so a double-click still works.

app.note: The browser app takes its launch parameters from the URL. They are defined here once; `fylite app --<name>` writes them into the URL it opens, and a gate asserts the pages read exactly these names.
